newsitem.title: TURKEY: Five firms seek Turkey barley at $121.46-$133.06/T.
newsitem.headline: Five firms seek Turkey barley at $121.46-$133.06/T.

text.p: Five firms bid on Monday at a Turkish Grain Board (TMO) tender to sell 150,000 tonnes of feed barley and 50,000 tonnes of malting barley for shipment in February and March, officials said.
They said Cargill, Glencore, Grains & Fourrages plus local companies Rotel and Sesos bid mostly to buy feed barley, while Glencore also sought malting barley at the public tender.
Prices ranged between $121.46 and $133.06 a tonne, depending on shipment dates and ports.
"All companies except Grains & Fourrages target Saudi Arabia to sell the feed barley. Grains & Fourrages may sell to Israel," said one participant at the tender.
Prices and other details were as follows:

--Grains & Fourrages: 1. $131.06 for 25,000 tonnes feed barley, shipment Mersin port on Feb 20-March 5 or March 5-20. 2. $133.06 for 25,000 tonnes feed barley or five vessels each with 5,000 tonnes, shipment Mersin port. At buyer's option.

--Rotel: 1. $127.05 for 50,000 tonnes feed barley for Mersin shipment on Feb 20-March 5. Seller's option. 2. $128.75 for 50,000 tonnes feed barley from Derince port on Feb 18. Seller's option. 3. $126.05 for 50,000 tonnes feed barley from Mersin on March 5-20. Seller's option.
--Sesos: 1. $127.15 for 50,000 tonnes feed barley. Seller's option. 2. $126.81 for 50,000 tonnes feed barley. Shipments at seller's option.

--Glencore: 1. $128.11 for 50,000 tonnes feed barley from Mersin or Derince. 2. $127.56 for 50,000 tonnes feed barley from Mersin or Derince. 3. $127.11 for 50,000 tonnes feed barley from Mersin or Derince or 50,000 tonnes malting barley at $17 plus agreed feed barley price.
--Cargill: $121.46 for 25,000 tonnes feed barley from Mersin on March 5-20.
Officials said they might announce the winner later on Monday.
